photos.title: Condo towers and smaller condo buildings on the ocean in Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront in the City of Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: on the left the edge of a glass tower, a tall tower with a red roof line and a tall tan tower with a small cupola, each with a pool deck behind the dunes and wooden walkways over the dunes to the beach; to the right a paved beach access lot and a small playground, then a road that curves inland, with a white mid-rise, a gray low-rise and brown low-rise buildings with pools across it. Houses and a golf course sit among trees behind. Beach umbrellas line the sand. People are too small to recognize; no plate, sign or building name is readable.
photos.caption: City of Myrtle Beach: condo towers on North Ocean Boulevard, seen from a plane in 2011.
photos.alt: Three tall oceanfront condo towers behind the dunes in Myrtle Beach, with smaller condo buildings across a curving road to the right and the beach and ocean in front

place.sublocation: North Ocean Boulevard, City of Myrtle Beach (tax district 880)

photos.title: Condo tower and low-rise condo buildings on South Ocean Boulevard, North Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront in North Myrtle Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: from left, a three-story gray condo building with a pool, a tan ten-story tower, a gray four-story building with a pool, and on the right a wide white fourteen-story tower with a pool deck and palms. Wooden walkways cross the dunes to the beach. A road runs behind the buildings, with older beach houses and trees beyond it. Beach umbrellas line the sand; people are too small to recognize.
photos.caption: North Myrtle Beach: a condo tower and low-rise condo buildings on South Ocean Boulevard, with beach houses behind, seen from a plane in 2011.
photos.alt: A wide white condo tower and three smaller condo buildings on the dunes in North Myrtle Beach, with a road and beach houses behind them and the beach in front

place.sublocation: South Ocean Boulevard, North Myrtle Beach (tax district 550)

photos.title: Condo towers and low-rise condo buildings on North Waccamaw Drive, Garden City Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront at Garden City Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: low-rise condo buildings with pools on the left, a tall tan tower in the middle, a white five-story building with a pool and the edge of another tower on the right. Streets of beach houses run back from the shore road to a wide salt marsh, with more houses on the far side of the marsh. Beach umbrellas line the sand; people are too small to recognize.
photos.caption: Garden City Beach, outside city limits: a condo tower and low-rise condo buildings on North Waccamaw Drive, with the marsh behind, seen from a plane in 2011.
photos.alt: A tall tan condo tower and several low-rise condo buildings with pools on the beach at Garden City, with beach houses and a wide salt marsh behind them

place.sublocation: North Waccamaw Drive, Garden City Beach, unincorporated Horry County (tax district 610)
